name: Mangrove restoration
description: Restoring mangrove forests to stabilize shorelines, sequester carbon and provide nursery habitat for fisheries.

name: Rainwater harvesting for households
description: Rooftop or surface collection systems to capture rainwater for domestic and irrigation use, reducing flood-runoff and boosting water security.
co_benefits: Household water security; reduced pressure on groundwater

name: Climate-smart agriculture: agroforestry
description: Integrating trees with crops and livestock to improve soil, increase resilience to drought, and diversify income.
co_benefits: Soil health; carbon sequestration; crop diversification

name: Permeable pavement
description: Replace impermeable surfaces with permeable materials to reduce urban runoff and reduce heat island effects.
co_benefits: Reduced flooding; groundwater recharge; cooler surfaces

name: Constructed wetlands for wastewater treatment
description: Engineered wetlands that treat wastewater naturally, reducing pollution and providing habitat.

name: Coastal dune restoration
description: Rebuilding dunes with native plants and natural structures to buffer waves and storm surge.

name: Early warning systems for floods
description: Sensor networks and communication systems that warn populations ahead of floods, enabling evacuation and preparation.

name: Elevated housing and infrastructure
description: Design and construct buildings on stilts or raised platforms to avoid flood damage.
co_benefits: Reduced asset loss; longer service life

name: Green roofs and urban greening
description: Planting vegetated roofs and urban trees to reduce heat, increase evapotranspiration, and manage stormwater.

name: Drought-tolerant crop varieties
description: Developing and deploying crop varieties that tolerate low water conditions to sustain production during dry periods.

name: Managed aquifer recharge
description: Artificial recharge of groundwater using infiltration basins or injection to store excess surface water for dry periods.

name: Floodplain restoration
description: Reconnecting rivers to their floodplains to store floodwaters naturally, reduce downstream flooding, and restore habitat.

name: Microinsurance for smallholders
description: Weather-indexed insurance products to protect farmers from crop failure and incentivize risk-reducing measures.

name: Salt-tolerant crop systems
description: Switching to or breeding salt-tolerant varieties or altering management to maintain production in salt-affected soils.

name: Urban flood retention parks
description: Design public parks that double as flood retention basins during heavy rainfall events.

name: Water-efficient irrigation (drip)
description: Drip and micro-irrigation systems that reduce water use and increase water productivity.

name: Solar-powered water pumping
description: Solar pumps for irrigation and water supply that reduce dependence on diesel and improve reliability.

name: Community-based mangrove aquaculture
description: Integrated aquaculture that restores mangroves while providing livelihoods and food security.

name: Road drainage upgrades
description: Improve roadside drainage to prevent washouts, maintain connectivity during extreme rainfall.

name: Riparian buffer strips
description: Vegetated buffers along streams to reduce erosion, filter runoff and improve bank stability.
